verdict.rationale: RUN's own package documentation says new employees fill out their own paperwork electronically before day one, covering personal info, direct deposit, and Form W-4. It also says Form I-9 can be completed electronically during new-hire onboarding, so the core self-serve flow is covered. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, explicit documentation of how the ops user sends or invites the new hire, explicit confirmation that I-9 is completed before day one, and clarity on which package tier includes these features.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can send a new hire a self-serve onboarding flow that collects W-4, I-9, and bank details before day one

citations.quote: letting new employees fill out their own paperwork electronically before their first day on the job: personal info, direct deposit, Form W-4, and more.
Complete Form I-9 electronically during new-hire onboarding.
